portraits.title: Portraits
portraits.description: You want portraits where you still feel like you - clean light, flattering angles, and relaxed direction. We’ll make images that look like you on your best day - confident, approachable, and real.

events.title: Events
events.description: You focus on your guests; I’ll quietly document the story - big moments and small details - with clean, consistent coverage you can share right away.

graduation.title: Graduation
graduation.description: You’ve earned it. We’ll make relaxed portraits on campus that feel celebratory and timeless - photos you’ll be proud to send to family and post the same day.

landscapes-and-travel.title: Landscapes & Travel
landscapes-and-travel.description: For you who love big skies and quiet places - clean, color‑true images that make you want to be there. Available as prints and licensing.

products.title: Products
products.description: You need images that sell: crisp lighting, consistent styling, and scroll‑stopping detail. Studio or on‑location, I’ll deliver clean, on‑brand photos ready for web and print.

street.title: Street
street.description: Candid, in‑between moments with strong composition - honest slices of the city that feel alive and unposed.

cosplay.title: Cosplay
cosplay.description: You want images that capture the magic of your costume. We’ll make photos that feel like you’re part of the story - authentic, tangible, and true to you.

nature.title: Nature
nature.description: The beauty of the natural world, as shot by me.

miscellaneous.title: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.description: A collection of images that don't fit into any other genre.
